state:
Goal `core-reflect-classinfo-and-1-more` (dossier), stage 2. `ClassInfo::attributes`, `::call` and
`::constant` are complete: tests from both sides, three examples, `about.md`, one attack and one
recorded bench each. `Core\Reflect\ClassInfo` has its class card and is off
`CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`. The `constant` bench found 3 allocations per read. The cause was the
reflective call site being decoded into owned strings, and it is fixed:
`nvs_runtime::source::member_of_operand` borrows the label, and `reflect.rs`'s `site_class` uses it
for `get`, `set`, `call`, `construct` and `constant`. Items 4 to 16 of the goal prose remain, and
every one owes an `about.md` too (goal prose § *The target*), which the check does not count.
No proof found a behaviour bug.
